about_the_game: When Rose ventures into the Mystic Woods to help her grandmother, she discovers a devastating truth: the forest’s magic is fading, and a ruthless logging pact threatens to destroy its very soul. There’s no choice for Rose other than to embrace her grandmother’s legacy and become a guardian. But who would have thought that Little Red Beauty would be accompanied on this dangerous quest by none other than a lone, brooding wolf? The fate of the forest now lies in the hands of the unlikely duo - and yours! Can you find a cure for the ancient trolls? Clean the magical river and save the sirens who call it home? Soothe the tensions with the local werewolf pack before conflict ignites? Of course, you won't have to do it alone: befriend the creatures of the forest and enlist their help! But beware... the lumberjacks are already sharpening their axes.
